name: 1А · Стрічка
prompt: Design exactly ONE original premium app icon symbol for Takt, a university planner. This is a flat graphic design asset, not a product photo. A single PURE WHITE solid silhouette with purposeful negative-space gaps on perfectly uniform solid cobalt #345DD2 canvas, edge to edge. Square 1024x1024 composition, centered mark within central 58% of canvas. No rounded-square container. Bold controlled geometric curves, professional optical balance, strong personality, recognizable at 24px. Minimal Swiss-modernist logo craftsmanship. Exact two solid colors only. NO shadows, gradients, dimensional shading, bevels, glow, texture, outlines, frames, additional icons, wordmarks, captions, watermark. Every structural idea must work as a one-color monochrome silhouette. Do not imitate a famous existing brand. Evolve a bold capital T into a distinctive folded ribbon monogram. Preserve instant T readability: broad horizontal cap and centered sturdy stem. The top right arm elegantly folds diagonally into the vertical stem with one wide blue diagonal negative-space fold seam. The stem ends in an oblique clipped foot, and the left arm has a softened squared terminal. Use a subtly asymmetric T, inspired by one precisely folded strip of paper. Two interlocking white shapes maximum. Flat silhouette, folds conveyed ONLY by deliberate blue space, never shades. More original than a standard T with a vertical slice. Confident iconic continuous motion, not a lightning bolt, not letter F, not an arrow.
